tasks.short: Coach and safeguard patients during exercises

steps.what: Read the therapist's current exercise plan and restrictions
Instruct and motivate the patient during exercise or functional activity
Physically assist and safeguard the patient as exercises are practised

tasks.design: Retain live exercise instruction, motivation and physical safeguarding. The clinical records system {OTHER} already shows the therapist's plan directly; actual response capture and formal progress-note writing are separately present in 15247 and 21192.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient safety depends on immediate physical support and responsive coaching.
tasks.enabler_now: No component changes an actual coaching or safeguarding action in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Fatigue, pain, balance and confidence change during practice.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant adapts encouragement and physical support to the patient's actual movement.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in live exercise time, treatment limits or responsibility.

evidence.claim: Exercise coaching and physical safeguarding remain hands-on work; this retained-work assessment is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is actual delivery of prescribed exercise, not independent treatment selection. The physical therapist supplies the current plan and restrictions in the clinical records system {OTHER}; unclear instructions require manual clarification within retained time.

Checked first writes and communication before assigning zero: 15247 explicitly contains response measurement entry and therapist handover; 21192 explicitly contains formal note composition and checking. Neither write is hidden inside these exercise steps or credited as saved here.
No routine exercise-completion log, new report or automated patient message is added. Direct source reading already exists, and no extra tool is deployed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Any additional real session record beyond the separately modelled response and progress note
research_questions: Is there a separate written exercise aid or record actually produced during this coaching task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All one hundred hours remain after explicitly locating real response capture and formal note writing in their own tasks. No changed read, write, send or physical action remains inside this live delivery boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write accurate patient histories and progress notes

steps.what: Review the treatment context and patient information needed for documentation
First record additional patient history and session facts in clinical records {OTHER}
Copy verified response measurements and identifiers into the formal progress-note fields
Compose the patient progress narrative from actual recorded facts

loop.input: Assistant-entered history, session actions and verified response fields
loop.output: Structured progress narrative distinguishing observed, reported and uncertain information
loop.check: Assistant edits in s4 and checks every clinical statement, attribution, unit, chronology and treatment-plan consistency in s5; no new diagnosis or treatment is allowed
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual writing; missing facts remain explicitly missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured fields first; varied patient accounts and session facts need prose beyond fixed field merging

steps.what: Check the complete note's clinical meaning against the original information
Save the note in the same clinical record

tasks.design: Configure native field reuse in the clinical records system {OTHER}, then draft the formal narrative from the assistant's actually entered facts. Keep all first capture and full clinical meaning checking; ordinary author saving stays unchanged and no diagnosis or treatment recommendation is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: First history capture, repeated measurement entry and formal narrative composition were treated as one writing activity.
tasks.enabler_now: Linked fields and source-bound drafting can address repetition without automating clinical conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Pain, response and progress need careful attribution and context.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant knows what was seen, what the patient reported and what the therapist must review.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat field entry and narrative composition, with the same treatment-plan and documentation responsibility.

reach.task: Review a useful treatment progress note

evidence.claim: Fysio.AI in Intramed drafts a structured intake report that the therapist checks and corrects; it supports a source-to-draft capability, not measured assistant progress-note savings.
Progress-note field reuse and the proposed labour shares are model knowledge and require local confirmation.

assumptions: Boundary is actual formal patient documentation. Response measurement first capture is explicitly present in 15247 s3; this task reuses that source and does not remove its capture time. Additional history and treatment facts are first captured here in s2 with no reduction.

The assistant supplies reported history, treatment performed and uncertainties; 15247 supplies patient ID, session ID, time, measured value, unit and response observation. Missing source fields are manually clarified within retained s1-s2. No ambient audio, free transcript or clean-note feed is assumed.

Ten repeated-entry hours concern copying actual response fields into a different formal note section, not saving the author's note. Of twenty-five narrative hours, ten are first prose composition and fifteen remain for editing; all nineteen final clinical-check hours remain.

Test native field links before custom code. Failed or ambiguous mappings require manual entry in retained s2/s5 time; verify that this allowance is sufficient locally. The one-hour ordinary save is retained and ungated; any separate therapist co-sign or consequential record release remains a distinct local action outside the claimed saving, not an automated self-approval.
unknowns: Whether formal notes currently repeat response fields
Actual therapist review and co-sign workflow
Approved drafting environment and correction time
research_questions: Does a source-bound draft preserve reported versus observed information after all corrections?
Can native note fields link measurements without adding mapping-repair work?

already_counted.description: Edit narrative and verify clinical meaning and source attribution

incremental.description: Maintain field links and draft restrictions and handle integration exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is ten actual repeat-field hours plus ten prose hours, less two upkeep = 18. Cautious case: a complex patient account needs all twenty-five narrative hours manually, while compatible response fields still avoid ten repeat-entry hours, less two upkeep = 8. First capture, clinical checking and ordinary saving are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe treatment response and give results to the therapist

steps.what: Observe the patient's responses during treatment and exercise
Measure relevant performance and response using the prescribed method
First enter measured responses in the clinical response fields {OTHER}
Evaluate progress and identify issues for the physical therapist
Give results and concerns to the physical therapist in person

tasks.design: Keep observation, measurement, progress evaluation and in-person therapist handover human. Configure only selected-patient and session headers in the clinical response form {OTHER}; the resulting factual fields are available to formal note writing in 21192 without recapturing them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated form context was mixed with clinical first capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-patient defaults can reuse known identifiers without judging response.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting pain, fatigue or a changed movement pattern requires direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant recognises changes worth discussing with the therapist immediately.
tasks.altitude: A small header-entry reduction; observation and handover time and scope are unchanged.

reach.task: Interpret a change in treatment response

evidence.claim: Native patient/session defaults can avoid repeat header entry without evaluating response; the allocation is model knowledge.

assumptions: This is the statement's in-person handover branch, with actual first response entry separately shown. The formal progress-note branch is explicitly modelled in 21192, where the exact response-field reuse and narrative work are present; no saving is deferred to an unread sibling.

The therapist supplies measurement method and plan. The assistant produces actual value, unit, time and response observation in fully retained measurement and near-fully retained s3. Selected patient/session IDs come from the current record; absent or wrong context is corrected manually in retained entry time.

Only 0.5 of ten first-entry hours is repeated patient/session header entry; 9.5 remain for all measurements, response facts, corrections and ordinary saving. All clinical evaluation and therapist conversation remain. No generated evaluation or automated treatment change is proposed.
Test native defaults first. Author saving stays within s3 without a gate or saving; this design sends no external message and creates no new progress log.
unknowns: How often handover is in person rather than written
research_questions: Does native session context remove any actual repeated header work while preserving correct patient attribution?

already_counted.description: First capture and verify actual response facts

incremental.description: Check response-form defaults after clinical record changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 0.5 repeated-header hours less 0.1 upkeep = 0.4. If the current response form already defaults patient and session, retain all ten entry hours and deploy no extra configuration, giving zero. Measurement, evaluation and handover receive no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach body mechanics and functional mobility techniques

steps.what: Read the therapist's prescribed mobility technique and patient restrictions
Choose understandable cues within the prescribed body-mechanics instruction
Demonstrate proper body mechanics or prescribed aquatic mobility exercise
Coach practice and check the patient's understanding and safe technique
Prepare and check the actual prescribed take-home instructions
Give the exact checked mobility handout to the identified patient

tasks.design: Keep demonstration, safe practice and cueing with the assistant. In the branch that already provides written take-home instructions, configure only repeated patient and session headings in {DOCS}; the assistant writes and checks the prescribed content and physically delivers the final handout.
tasks.previous_blocker: Live instruction dominates; only small repeated handout headings are candidates for change.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields can use existing patient context without selecting exercises.
tasks.still_hard: A correct handout cannot replace checking actual movement and comprehension.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant changes the explanation when the patient cannot perform or understand the technique.
tasks.altitude: A small handout-header reduction where written instructions are already used; no change to therapy authority or live practice.

evidence.claim: Native handout headings can reduce repeat entry without changing prescribed instruction; this is a conditional model-knowledge design, not an observed practice baseline.

assumptions: Boundary includes an existing prescribed take-home handout only where the assistant actually prepares one today. This is not a new trailing treatment record. General exercise assistance in 2008 and this specific technique instruction may occur together; team roll-up must not add the same live coaching action twice.

The therapist supplies exact technique, limits and restrictions. The assistant supplies patient-specific wording and checks meaning against the prescription in retained s5 time. Selected patient/session context supplies only identity headings; missing context is manually entered and checked, not provided by a free integration.

Only 0.9 of nine preparation hours is repeated headings; 8.1 remains for actual instruction writing, readability, clinical meaning checking, printing and ordinary saving. All live work and physical delivery remain. Test native document fields first.

The s5 check occurs after the final handout exists and binds its exact instruction, restrictions and patient identity. A changed handout requires rechecking. This gates delivery to the patient, not the author's same-system save.
unknowns: Whether take-home instructions are actually prepared here
Actual safe technique and prescription workflow
research_questions: Is repeated handout heading entry present after current template configuration?

already_counted.description: Write and check the full prescribed handout meaning

incremental.description: Maintain handout headings and patient-context fields

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final printed mobility handout, prescribed instructions and restrictions and identified patient recipient; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is 0.9 heading hours less 0.2 upkeep = 0.7. Cautious case: instructions are wholly verbal or the current written template already supplies headings; no extra configuration is deployed and all current work remains, giving zero. No physical or conversational time is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant retains patient coaching, safeguarding, direct observation and work within the therapist's plan. Actual note-field reuse and bounded narrative drafting are separate from first clinical capture.
reach: Work with the physical therapist on useful factual progress information
skills_to_grow: Check observed versus reported clinical information
role.ambitious_version: An assistant with less repeated documentation while preserving hands-on patient support and clear therapist handover.
